output.answer_markdown: As of May 26, 2023, PepsiCo could borrow up to a combined **$8.4 billion** under its two new unsecured revolving credit agreements. That is $4.2 billion under the 2023 364-Day Credit Agreement [1] plus $4.2 billion under the 2023 Five-Year Credit Agreement [3]. The earlier $3.8 billion agreements were terminated effective May 26, 2023 [1][3]. Commitments under each new agreement could be increased to up to $4.95 billion with lender agreement [1][2].

claims.text: On May 26, 2023, PepsiCo entered into a new $4.2 billion 364-day unsecured revolving credit agreement.
